examples.title: Styled text
examples.implementation_note: Upstream typography with the original character grid, CJK/emoji and type-scale specimens; GPUI layout/SceneSnapshot with browser-host font fallback, scroll and pointer extensions. Interactive/browser parity is unverified.

examples.title: Text layout
examples.implementation_note: gpui.mbt layout and SceneSnapshot with explicit Canvas font-style and text-decoration host extensions; conformance unverified.

examples.title: Text wrapping
examples.implementation_note: MoonBit wrapping and truncation with gpui.mbt layout and SceneSnapshot; browser font metrics and grapheme segmentation are explicit host inputs. Shaping and conformance remain unverified.

examples.title: Text input
examples.implementation_note: MoonBit TextField/TextComposition own edit, UTF-16 selection, undo/redo and composition; browser IME/Clipboard is host-only. Fixed scalar advance proxy, Japanese IME and pixel/native conformance unverified.

examples.title: Dynamic fonts
examples.implementation_note: MoonBit gpui.mbt Element -> layout -> prepaint -> SceneSnapshot. Missing-glyph detection and remote FontFace registration are explicit browser-host approximations; Cosmic Text shaping and pixel equivalence remain unverified.

examples.title: Prime sieve
examples.implementation_note: Actual MoonBit brute-force computation in browser Web Workers, with gpui.mbt layout, pointer dispatch and SceneSnapshot. Worker scheduling, fonts and Canvas rounded fills are explicit host extensions; conformance and performance equivalence unverified.

examples.title: Deep tree
examples.implementation_note: Unchanged upstream default depth 50: 51 colored blocks with 2px padding. gpui.mbt auto measurement, layout and SceneSnapshot; block flow is represented by single-child stretched columns. Native and arbitrary-depth parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Nested scrollable
examples.implementation_note: Real gpui.mbt core viewport limits, wheel routing, descendant translation, scene clips and clipped pointer hits. Same-delta ancestor behavior and anonymous-hover invalidation follow unchanged upstream source. Browser text metrics/rasterization remain host extensions; native and full-pixel equivalence unverified.

examples.title: Focus-visible
examples.implementation_note: Real gpui.mbt Element layout/prepaint/SceneSnapshot with a persistent input tree, core flat tab traversal, modality, focus ownership and routing. Pointer and keyboard activation follow the pinned upstream source. JavaScript input delivery, rounded fills, solid 4px focus borders and browser fonts are explicit host boundaries. Source-derived candidate only; paired browser execution and pixel qualification remain unverified. Nested tab groups, touch, pointer capture, native, full-image and text parity are not established.

examples.title: Tab stops and groups
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived candidate using genuine Element layout/prepaint/SceneSnapshot, core group-prefix traversal and owner-preserving live geometry refresh. Source border-box flex and this bounded Block-group profile are explicitly lowered into existing flex APIs. Shared browser input transport, Canvas border3/shadow_sm and font metrics are host extensions. Paired browser execution, native, GPU shadow-kernel, text and full-image parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Typed drag and drop
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived candidate using genuine Element layout/prepaint/SceneSnapshot and typed core DragSession for admission, activation, hit testing and one-shot delivery. Preview copies preserve the original typed payload. Browser pointer delivery, font metrics, signed preview placement and Canvas shadow_md are explicit host boundaries. Paired browser execution, native, touch, global capture, GPU shadow-kernel, text and full-image parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Uniform list
features: Lazy visible ranges and full extent
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived candidate using genuine core UniformList prototype measurement, lazy range construction, Element layout/prepaint/SceneSnapshot and clipped wheel/row routing. Browser font metrics, unhinted prefix measurements and hinted Canvas glyph rasterization are explicit host boundaries. Strict text-envelope comparison exposes known per-row right-edge raster differences (including Item 3); it is not a passed full-text comparison. Separately scoped placement/scroll/clip results require exact paired evidence. Factory/callback observations use a separate font-free GPUI diagnostic. Native, fractional translation, text and full-image parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Responsive grid layout
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived candidate using genuine core container_query_root, deferred prepaint and grid/flex layout with five equal-fraction tracks, spans and a 224px overflowing table of contents. The unchanged comparison profile is widths 399/400/401/500px, height 500px, DPR 1. Live rendering accepts resource-bounded viewport sizes and DPRs, labels outside-profile rendering as unverified, and rejects invalid or oversized canvases. Source Block text starts at its 1px border inset, with browser font metrics and bounded MoonBit word wrapping. Canvas rounded dashed borders and both shadow_lg layers remain explicit approximations. Content preflight and frame each request a fresh core layout, for two host layout passes; this is not Rust callback-count parity. Paired browser, text, full-image, shadow-kernel and native parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Anchored hover popovers
features: Core viewport clipping and hit testing
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived bounded candidate using genuine core grid/flex layout, anchored_after Local placement, snap-to-window, deferred prepaint and hit routing. Browser text measurements, Canvas rounded border/shadow_sm and pointer/viewport transport are explicit host boundaries. Live viewport: width 4–4096 and height 4–16384, DPR0.25–4, rounded Canvas sides at most 16384 and area at most 33554432 pixels. Frozen comparison profile remains widths 750 and 480, height 600, DPR1; all other viewports remain unverified. Popup dimensions derive from measured label widths, source min_w100, px2/py0p5 and device-snapped phi line height at text_sm14. Paired browser, text raster, exact shadow/opacity, full-image, native and callback-count parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Gradient color spaces
features: Twelve gradient quads and two solids
Core float sampling and ordered raster transport
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived candidate using genuine core ElementTree layout/prepaint, dispatch, canonical Scene/PaintCommand and float gradient sampling. Frozen comparison profiles are 960×600 and 600×960, DPR1. Live logical sizes width240–2048 and height300–2048 retain actual device layout scale; effective raster resolution is explicitly reduced to fit 2048-side/1048576-pixel core caps. Browser font measurements and Canvas text/pixel presentation are host boundaries. Equal-stop core policy is deterministic and backend-scoped. Paired browser, text, antialias edges, arbitrary translucent/interleaved-text composition, full-image and native/Metal parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Nested popovers
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived candidate using genuine core Element layout/prepaint/SceneSnapshot, deferred priorities, anchored placement and outside-pointer routing. Bundled IBM Plex Sans loads before actual prefix measurement; MoonBit owns wrapping, geometry, hit testing and open/dismiss state. JavaScript transports trusted primary-mouse events and paints. Live host accepts width/height 1–8192, DPR0.25–4 with rounded Canvas sides at most16384 and area at most33554432 pixels. The runtime has broader numeric bounds, not a browser parity claim. Canvas text, rounded borders and shadow_lg are explicit approximations. Paired browser, native, text, shadow, full-image and callback-count parity remain unverified.

examples.title: Slash patterns
examples.implementation_note: Source-derived ElementTree layout and canonical core SlashPattern rasterization. Frozen 600×600 DPR1 only. Browser-measured label ink is checked disjoint from source-later paint before labels-last normalization; the opaque core paint run preserves linear alpha composition. Canvas text is a host approximation. Root shadow kernel, text, full-image, arbitrary viewport and native parity remain unverified.
